targeted_test_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/<file>.py — there is NO pytest and NO runner in this project: every test file is a standalone executable that exits non-zero on failure, so run exactly the files your slice names, directly. Monitoring-suite files live under tests/monitoring/ and are run the same way. Keep PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 on every hand-typed invocation: without it an aggregator/__pycache__ lands in the payload and reddens tests/test_package.py.
full_suite_command: tests/run_all.sh --keep-going    # BOTH suites (Touch + monitoring), reporting every failure; tests/run_all.sh alone is the fail-fast form, and tests/run_all.sh --list shows what would run, in order
baseline_notes: Baseline is recorded per run in the run spec's baseline_notes override — treat any failure NOT named there as new and caused by this change.
review_checklist: correctness first; then this repo's settled law, which outranks generic style: stdlib-only on the ingest/serve path (GD-21 — pymongo only from mongo_store.py/mirror.py, lazily); never write under ~/.claude/; status.sh is the ONLY write path into events.jsonl, which is append-only and POSITIONAL (Mongo keys are legacy:<task>#<line>) so no line is ever rewritten, reordered or truncated; the [monitor] marker is FENCED (GD-D1a) and never trimmed, renamed or moved; hooks are additive and never the floor (GD-D5); no session-control verb and no CONTROL_ROUTES entry; event detail strings stay short, single-line, free of double quotes, under the 1 KB writer cap (GD-11); one file has exactly one owner; no new file under plugin/touch/shared/monitoring/ (the six-file pin) and no new aggregator module. Then: a fabricated or guessed number on a card is the R-58 defect class and is worse than showing nothing — absent must never be spelled as 0 or null on the wire; tautological or fragile tests; needless rewrites beyond the slice's scope; and any always-on file (CLAUDE.md, .touch/memory/MEMORY.md, skill description: lines) grown without re-measuring the context budget.
